sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
We value our long-standing relationship and are willing to consider a 24-month contract to provide you with planning security.
In return for the extended term, we can offer a revised price of €51.40 per unit.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
We acknowledge your revised offer, but it still falls short of a sustainable level for our foundry.
To demonstrate our commitment to our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to make a further concession to €50.90 per unit.
Please understand that our flexibility is now very limited, and we expect a more realistic step from your side to reach an agreement.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €49.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
We acknowledge your revised proposal and the step you have taken.
As we have reached the absolute limit of what is sustainable for our foundry, we are now submitting our final offer of €49.90 per unit.
We have stood by our partners through challenging times, and we trust this final concession reflects our commitment to our 12-year relationship.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
